purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body: To be provided: what the service offers and what these terms cover.

access.title: Access to the network
access.body: To be provided: who may join the network, and on what conditions.

conduct.title: Rules of use
conduct.body: To be provided: what is allowed and what is forbidden.

content.title: Published content
content.body: To be provided: the rights over content published by members and how it is shared.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.body: To be provided: how content is reviewed, removed or restored, and how to challenge a decision.

liability.title: Responsibilities
liability.body: To be provided: the responsibilities of the publisher and those of members.

termination.title: Suspension and closing an account
termination.body: To be provided: when an account may be suspended or closed, and how to leave.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: To be provided: how members are told about a change to these terms.

law.title: Applicable law
law.body: To be provided: the applicable law and how disputes are settled.

report.title: Report content
report.body: A post's menu offers “Report…”, as do mutual aid, mentoring and job content. The network's moderation team reviews the report; its author does not learn who reported it.

messages.title: Write to a member
messages.body: Members reach each other through messaging, open between connections. No member's address or phone number is published.

data.title: Your data and your reports
data.body: Export your data, erase your account, follow a decision about you or the outcome of your reports: it is all done from “My data”, even without a membership.

publisher.title: Write to the publisher
publisher.body: To be provided: the publisher's contact address.

dataProtection.title: Personal data
dataProtection.body: To be provided: where to send a request about your personal data.

texts.lead: The site's texts, with their version and date. Those not yet provided, or not yet reviewed, say so.
